landing.hero.title: SentiLens
landing.hero.subtitle: AI-powered employee feedback intelligence
landing.hero.description: Companies collect feedback through surveys, forms and suggestion boxes — but analyzing hundreds of responses by hand is hard. SentiLens uses AI to understand sentiment, emotions and recurring topics, while protecting anonymity.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.features.title: Features
landing.privacy.title: Privacy & anonymity
landing.v2.realtimeSub: as soon as feedback is submitted
landing.v2.privacyBody: Feedback is never linked to an identity. Detailed statistics only appear once a group is large enough to protect anonymity.
landing.v2.ctaTitle: Ready to truly listen to your team?
landing.v2.ctaSub: Log in or create your account with an invitation code.
